requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: CV mentions supporting 'factory acceptance testing of receiver hardware, focusing on functional verification and test procedure execution' but does not name RF-specific test equipment or measurements (network analyser, spectrum analyser, anechoic chamber, RF front-end calibration).

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: My background is not the conventional one for this field. I studied economics at the Merihaka University, not engineering, and I came into signal processing through what was initially a data management role at Tuulenkaari.
Twenty years of that trajectory has given me a practical working knowledge of signal processing systems that I could not have planned when I started.

requirements.note: Stated degree (Economics) is not in the requirement's named fields, and the cover letter explicitly says 'I do not have formal training in the mathematical foundations of signal processing'. Status reflects the concrete on-the-job detail quoted above (calibration-data processing, workflow design, test procedures) as possible demonstrated-equivalent competence; whether it counts as equivalent, given the candidate's own caveat, is a judgement call for the recruiter.

requirements.name: Kalman filtering / estimation theory

lines.quote: I have some experience with Kalman filtering and estimation theory

requirements.note: Asserted with no named project or further detail.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience

lines.quote: at various points in my career I have taken on team-lead responsibilities, though these have been informal rather than titled -- stepping in when a project needed someone to coordinate schedules and keep things on track rather than holding a management position

requirements.note: Candidate explicitly describes this as informal coordination rather than a titled or formal leadership position.

requirements.name: EU work authorisation

lines.quote: Finnish citizen; held security clearances required for classified government and EU-framework programme contracts at Tuulenkaari

requirements.note: Text states Finnish citizenship rather than the phrase 'EU work authorisation' itself; Finnish citizenship directly entails EU/EEA work rights, so this is recorded as evidence_found on that basis.

lines.quote: Rewrote Tuulenkaari's customer-facing technical documentation library into English as part of the company's expansion into international markets
Authored operator manuals, test reports, and interface control documents in English for non-Finnish customers

requirements.name: Onsite in Oulu / relocation

lines.quote: What draws me to this role specifically is Oulu. I grew up there and my parents still live in the city.
Returning to Oulu would make this more than a career move for me.

requirements.note: Candidate is currently based in Helsinki (per CV) and describes this role as an opportunity to relocate to Oulu.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ running on real hardware under real timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
